mapper.update: UPDATE trip_article ta JOIN chat_room cr ON ta.id = cr.trip_article_id JOIN ( SELECT chat_room_id, COUNT(id) AS cnt FROM chat_participants WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY chat_room_id ) cp ON cr.id = cp.chat_room_id SET ta.status = 'MATCHED' WHERE ta.max_participants = cp.cnt AND ta.id = #{travelArticleId} AND cr.id = #{chatRoomId}
UPDATE trip_article SET status = 'MATCHED' WHERE id = #{travelArticleId} AND status = 'OPEN'
UPDATE trip_article SET status = 'MATCHED' WHERE status = 'OPEN' AND NOW() >= recruit_end_date

UPDATE trip_article ta LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cr.trip_article_id, COUNT(cp.id) AS active_participants FROM chat_room cr JOIN chat_participants cp ON cr.id = cp.chat_room_id WHERE cp.status = 'ACTIVE' AND cr.trip_article_id = #{tripId} GROUP BY cr.trip_article_id ) AS participants_count ON ta.id = participants_count.trip_article_id SET ta.status = CASE WHEN COALESCE(participants_count.active_participants, 0) >= ta.max_participants THEN 'MATCHED' ELSE 'OPEN' END WHERE ta.id = #{tripId} AND ta.status IN ('OPEN', 'MATCHED')
